title: Coupling Matters: Finite-Horizon Transport Analysis for Quantized Masked Diffusion Language Models
description: Preprint / technical report; not peer reviewed. Post-training quantization of masked diffusion language models can alter token choices, commit sets, and subsequent states. This technical report develops a finite-horizon transport framework in which the coupling used to synchronize full-precision and quantized generation is part of the measured upper bound. The central first-divergence result controls terminal distortion by residual masked mass. The artifact includes complete proofs, fixed-suite and declared prompt-population analyses, second-model and official-sampler validations, independent audits, and preregistered negative investigations of additive token metrics, terminal lower-bound witnesses, and transport-weighted calibration. This record is a technical report and has not undergone peer review.
